name: skeleton-sender
description: TODO(author): the one effect it makes at which service. DRY_RUN defaults to true: nothing is sent until it is set to false.

AUTH_HEADER.description: 'Bearer ' and a vault reference to the service's token, e.g. 'Bearer vault://<path>'. The platform puts the secret in the header; the module never sees it. Grant the installed copy exactly that path.

DRY_RUN.description: When true (the default), report what would be sent and send nothing. Set to false to send.

setup_instructions.title: Store the token
setup_instructions.detail: Store a token for the service that may make this one change, in the vault, and grant the installed copy exactly that path.

setup_instructions.title: Configure, and rehearse
setup_instructions.detail: Set AUTH_HEADER. Leave DRY_RUN true for the first runs, read what it would send, then set it to false.
